findings.title: Nil plugin requests panic before logger nil-guards
findings.body: ContextualLoggerMiddleware.QueryData, CallResource, CheckHealth, and CollectMetrics dereference req (req.PluginContext) with no nil check before calling next. LoggerMiddleware, which now sits inside this middleware, explicitly handles a nil request by skipping logging and forwarding the call. A nil QueryData/CallResource/CheckHealth/CollectMetrics request that previously passed through the stack now panics in instrumentContext's caller, so the request never reaches the plugin client.

findings.title: Request-completed logs no longer include traceID
findings.body: LoggerMiddleware used to append traceID from tracing.TraceIDFromContext(ctx, false) on every "Plugin Request Completed" (grafana-data-egress) line, along with pluginId, endpoint, uname, dsName, and dsUID. Those fields were removed in favor of m.logger.FromContext(ctx), but instrumentContext only stores endpoint, pluginId, dsName, dsUID, and uname via log.WithContextualAttributes. Nothing puts traceID into that attribute set, so completion logs lose the trace correlation field even when a trace ID is present on the context.

findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext drops recorded logs
findings.body: TestLogger.FromContext ignores the receiver and returns NewTestLogger(). LoggerMiddleware now emits "Plugin Request Completed" via logger.FromContext(ctx).Info, so any test that injects *TestLogger and asserts InfoLogs will see zero calls: the Info is written to a discarded logger. The fake also fails the new interface contract that FromContext returns a logger carrying this logger's context.
